description: FILE credential cache written by MIT krb5 (kinit + kvno against Active Directory), format version 4. Sanitised with length-preserving substitution: realm -> EXAMPLE-REALM.TEST, client -> testuser, service -> service; every session key replaced by fixed bytes and every ticket blob by 0xA5 bytes, so no usable credential remains.
source: MIT Kerberos 1.22 kinit/kvno, Active Directory KDC
